title: feat(setup): part-in-spindle mode and table tool stations on a mill
body:
## What changed

- A mill setup can state part-in-spindle mode. The mill spindle holds the bar in a collet. Lathe tools stand on the table.
- `SetupDef::part_in_spindle` (new module `crates/app/src/part_in_spindle.rs`) holds:
  - the stock's length offset register `H` (for `G43 H255`);
  - the collet stick-out and outer diameter, mm;
  - the table stations. Each station gives one tool its own 1-based work offset, an approach side (`-X` or `+X`) and a spindle direction (`M3` or `M4`).
- Two undoable commands (`crates/app/src/commands/part_in_spindle.rs`):
  - `SetPartInSpindle` states, changes or clears the mode. A change keeps the stations.
  - `SetTableStation::put` / `::remove` puts or removes one station.
  - Each command validates the whole next record. It refuses a bad holding, a work offset out of range, a missing tool, and two tools on one work offset, by name.
  - The mode is refused on a machine that is not a mill. It is not stated over a milling operation. It is not cleared while the setup has an operation.
- MCP tools `set_part_in_spindle` and `set_table_station` run the same commands. `get_job` shows `part_in_spindle` for each setup. Both tools are approval-gated as limit edits in live MCP (`mcp/live.rs`).
- The project file keeps the record as an additive key. The loader refuses a record that the commands would refuse, by name.
- The family door (`family_gate`, and again at the post in `posting_family`): an active mode admits the Turn family and a Drill with no cross holes. It refuses milling kinds and cross holes by name.
- Generation and the spindle law read `part_in_spindle::work_kind`, which is `Lathe` in an active mode. The part turns, so the lathe's laws apply:
  - the axial door refuses an off-centre hole by name;
  - the spindle law refuses a bar whose axis is not world Z through the work offset.
- The collet's rating: an unset `workholding_max_rpm` blocks the post by name. The work-spindle limit of #1031/#1174 now applies to a part-in-spindle mill (`setup_workholding::work_speed`).
- The post: no post section writes the stock's `G43 H`, one work offset for each tool, or the station's spindle word yet. A turning section through a milling post would come out as milling. So the program gate refuses a part-in-spindle setup that has work, by name. A follow-up issue owns the post section.
- Docs: the generated `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md` and the guide's MCP tool table list the two tools (the `mcp_doc_drift` contract).

## Cause

This is a new feature (part of #2580). Before this change, `Family::admits` refused all turning work on `Kind::Mill`, and a setup had one work offset only.

## Tests

Pins (new files in existing directory suites, no new test binary):

- `crates/app/tests/machine/part_in_spindle.rs` (suite `machine`):
  - `turning_is_admitted_only_in_part_in_spindle_mode_and_generates_and_cuts_on_the_field`: a plain mill refuses Facing; in the mode, Facing is admitted, generates `Ok`, and the lathe field eye cuts the faced end; an axial Drill is admitted; an off-centre hole is refused at generation by name; a cross drill is refused by name; clearing the mode names the op.
  - `an_axial_drill_off_the_spindle_line_is_refused_by_the_spindle_law`
  - `the_mode_and_stations_are_validated_undoable_commands`: bad holdings, a shared work offset (named), offset 0, a missing tool, replace, remove, undo and redo restore the record exactly.
  - `a_lathe_setup_refuses_the_mode`
  - `the_collets_rpm_is_required_and_enforced_and_the_post_is_refused_by_name`: an unset rating blocks `post_script` by name; a G97 op at 3000 rpm over a 2000 rpm collet is refused; the post-section refusal names the setup.
  - `the_mode_and_stations_round_trip_in_the_project_file`: byte-identical round trip, a corrupt record refused by name, no key without the mode.
- `crates/app/tests/mcp/part_in_spindle.rs` (suite `mcp`): `part_in_spindle_tools_configure_the_mode_and_refuse_milling`.

Pin proof: on unchanged `upstream/main` the pins do not compile (`unresolved import camcraft_app::part_in_spindle`, `unresolved imports camcraft_app::commands::SetPartInSpindle, SetTableStation`).

Mutation checks (each file put back to `upstream/main`, pins run, file restored, pins green again):

| Guard | Pins with the old code |
|---|---|
| `family_gate` door hook | red (2 tests) |
| `posting_family` door hook | red (`the_collets_rpm_...`: the generic family refusal comes first) |
| `job.rs` work kind | red (the off-centre hole generates) |
| `spindle_law::turns` work kind | red (`an_axial_drill_off_the_spindle_line_...`) |
| `setup_workholding` collet as chucked | red (the G97 over the rating passes) |
| `posting.rs` program problems | red (an unset rating does not block) |

Gate results:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` (code head `160a5b9e2`, merged with `upstream/main` `b6089ea6e`; the last commit after it changes only `docs/decisions/3406-part-in-spindle.md`): 546 steps in 62.3 min. 544 ok, 1 failed, 1 skipped.
  - FAIL `app suites: cadmpeg_import` (`stub::a_hung_program_is_stopped_at_the_time_limit_and_its_folder_removed`, `stub::output_past_the_capture_limit_stops_the_program`). These are time-limit tests of a stub program, run under full gate load. Run alone on the same head: 13 passed, 0 failed. This PR does not touch the import code.
  - SKIP `site tests`: `node` is not installed on this machine. The guide edit is one table row; `mcp_doc_drift` (9 tests) reads it and is green.
  - The `example_catalog*` suites ran in the plan: ok.

- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `mcp_doc_drift`, `mcp_workholding`, `lathe_workholding_rpm`: green.

## Goldens moved

None. No `*.nc`, `*.cl` or `examples/catalog/**` file changes (`git diff --stat upstream/main -- "*.nc" "*.cl" examples/` is empty). The `example_catalog*` suites ran in the quick gate (results above).

## Not exercised

- No post output for a part-in-spindle setup. The post is refused by name on purpose (follow-up #4486).
- No UI rows on the Setups page; the ribbon still hides the turning kinds on a mill (follow-up #4487). No screenshots: no UI change.
- No heavy step: this is a `P6` PR, and AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review" gives a `P2` or lower PR no heavy step.
- Light lane: not run to the end. `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main` started, but its release build stalled for more than 40 minutes on small crates (tokio, serde) behind the shared `sccache`. A release build of another worktree on this machine stalled the same way. The run was stopped. AGENTS.md makes a red or missing light run a note, not a block. The reviewer can run it.
- The `camcraft-mcp` skill (a process file) has no row for the two tools. The generated reference and the guide list them.

## Overlaps

- #4288 (laser, draft, `conflicts`) edits `family_gate` in other lines and `Family::admits`. This PR adds four lines at the top of `family_gate`. Different hunks; whichever merges second refreshes. Not stacked: #4288 is a conflicted draft feature.
- #4379 touches `gates.rs` (imports and other functions), `posting.rs`, `project/apply.rs`: different functions.
- #4066 touches `schema.rs` and `project/apply.rs`: different fields and lines.
- #4463, #4302, #4238 touch `mcp/mod.rs`, `mcp/live.rs`, `mcp/tools.rs` registration lists: one added line each.

Writer record: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/issues/3406#issuecomment-7229589585

Effort: high

Changelog: Setups: a mill setup can hold the part in its spindle with lathe tools on the table (part-in-spindle mode, table tool stations with their own work offsets); turning operations and an on-centre Drill generate and simulate there, milling is refused by name, the collet's max rpm is required, and the post is refused by name until a post section voices the stations (MCP `set_part_in_spindle`, `set_table_station`).

Fixes #3406
